sloka: किमर्थं नगरद्वारमिदं रुध्द्वा विनर्दसि ।दुन्दुभे विदितो मेऽसि रक्षप्राणान्महाबल ॥४-११-३०॥।।
transliteration: kimarthaṁ nagaradvāramidaṁ rudhdvā vinardasi ।dundubhe vidito me'si rakṣaprāṇānmahābala ॥4-11-30॥।।

translations.english: 'O Dundubhi why are you roaring, blocking the entrance of the city? I know you are powerful. Go and save your life.'
